app.setup.title_default.why: Plain statement of the missing state, matches Apple Settings register.

app.setup.title_failed.s: Không rõ trạng thái tiện ích
app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged wording distinct from the plain not-yet-on state above.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Khi trang được bảo vệ, không thao tác nhấn nào bị cướp nữa.
app.setup.detail_default.back: When a site is guarded, no press gets hijacked anymore.
app.setup.detail_default.why: States the payoff impersonally, no reader pronoun needed.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Không thể hỏi được Safari lần này. Nếu tiện ích đã bật, ứng dụng sẽ tự nhận ra.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Could not ask Safari this time. If the extension is on, the app will notice on its own.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: Two plain clauses, no error code, reassures no refresh is needed.

app.setup.open_button.s: Mở Cài đặt Tiện ích Safari
app.setup.open_button.why: Names the one action; works on both the setup screen and the welcome sheet.

app.welcome.heading.why: Warmer first-launch register, Apple's own onboarding phrasing pattern.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Concrete noun phrase naming the trick, no marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Một lớp vô hình có thể phủ lên trang, khiến cú nhấn trúng nhầm chỗ khác.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer can cover the page, making a press land on the wrong spot.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would see, not the mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Short concrete noun phrase matching sibling feature titles.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Một số trang đổi đích liên kết ngay giữa lúc nhấn và lúc thả tay.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some sites change the link's destination right between pressing and releasing.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Plain description of the timing trick from the user's side.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Concrete noun phrase, matches the feature-row title pattern.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Khi bật bảo vệ, tab mới chỉ mở đúng nơi cú nhấn nhắm tới.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: With guard on, a new tab only opens exactly where the press aimed.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Phrased as a promise, not a description of the trick itself; no reader pronoun.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Two words, names the rule-list feature plainly.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Mỗi đích đến có mục riêng để chọn cho phép hay chặn, tại đây hoặc mọi nơi.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Each destination has its own entry to choose allow or block, here or everywhere.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Explains the review-and-scope mechanism without addressing the reader directly.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Names the per-site opt-in mechanism concisely.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Nhấn nút Undirect trên thanh công cụ Safari để bảo vệ trang đang mở.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Press the Undirect button on Safari's toolbar to guard the site currently open.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: States the exact mechanism, matches other detail sentences' concreteness.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Short enough for a narrow sidebar column, doubles as nav title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Vietnamese term for this screen, not a synonym.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Pairs as the clear opposite of app.rules.grouping.by_site.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Reads as the contrasting counterpart to 'Mọi nơi' beside it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.s: Chưa kết nối được tiện ích
app.rules.empty_no_app.title.back: Not yet connected to the extension
app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring/first-contact state, distinct from 'no rules yet'.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Mở một trang bất kỳ trong Safari, danh sách sẽ tự hiện.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open any page in Safari, the list will appear on its own.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: States the simple fix, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Plainly states this particular list is empty, contrasts with the first-contact title.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Đích đến chỉ hiện ở đây khi đã được cho phép hoặc chặn.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A destination only shows up here once it has been allowed or blocked.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains that a decision, not just being seen, creates an entry.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.s: Đã chặn %lld lần trên mọi trang.
app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Vietnamese has no plural inflection, one form covers every count value.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Reused state word, pairs opposite app.rules.row.state_allowed.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Imperative verb, only shown on a currently blocked row.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: Chọn cho phép hay chặn đích đến này
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Choose to allow or block this destination
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Describes what the hovered control does.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the explicit rule, not setting a new verdict.

app.watched.empty.title.why: Plainly states no site has been switched on.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Nhấn nút Undirect trên thanh công cụ khi đang ở trang hay gây phiền.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Press the Undirect button on the toolbar while on a site that keeps causing trouble.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Tells exactly how to guard the first site, plain register.

app.watched.footer.s: Muốn thêm trang, dùng nút Undirect trên thanh công cụ Safari.
app.watched.footer.back: To add a site, use the Undirect button on Safari's toolbar.
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds that the list only grows from the toolbar button.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Read-only ongoing-state word, not a button on this platform.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb fitting a small trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.s: Tắt bảo vệ cho trang này
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turn off guard for this site
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes what the Stop button under the pointer does.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The master switch label, same word used as the concept name throughout.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state word, reused for more than one setting.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the choice of which sites the guard runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, the conservative default.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Names the automatic always-on mode plainly.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Labels the on-page banner toggle, distinct from the popup's own record.

app.settings.policy_heading.s: Xử lý đích đến chưa có quy tắc
app.settings.policy_heading.back: Handling for a destination with no rule
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the default-policy choice for an unrated destination.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short picker option, unrated destination stopped by default.

ext.meta.name.why: Proper noun, same brand name as app.nav.app_title, left untranslated.

ext.meta.description.s: Ngăn trang web lợi dụng cú nhấn để mở hoặc chuyển hướng sang nơi không mong muốn.
ext.meta.description.back: Stops sites exploiting a press to open or redirect to an unwanted place.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for someone who has never used the extension, slightly explanatory.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, same brand name kept untranslated.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the icon's current on-state as its accessible tooltip.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.s: Chưa bảo vệ, nhấn để bật
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.back: Not guarded, press to turn on
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Tooltip doubles as the call to action; comma instead of a dash connector.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.s: Không có trang để bảo vệ
ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains there is nothing to guard on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.s: Chỉ hoạt động trên trang web
ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Popup headline explaining Undirect needs an actual website.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Mở một trang web, rồi nhấn vào đây để bảo vệ.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a website, then press here to guard it.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: 'Đây' keeps the self-reference to the button the popup hangs off of.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: Bật hoặc tắt bảo vệ cho trang này
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn guard on or off for this site
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader label naming what the switch controls, no visual context needed.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.s: Không có trang nào để bảo vệ ở đây.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.back: There is no page here to guard.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Explains why the per-site switch is disabled.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: Đang bật chế độ bảo vệ mọi trang.
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: The guard-every-site mode is already on.
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because the everywhere mode already covers it.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.s: Bảo vệ đang tắt trong Cài đặt.
ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Explains the disabled switch is about the master toggle, not this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: Đang bảo vệ trang này. Tắt sẽ tải lại trang.
ext.popup.watch_on.back: Guarding this site now. Turning off will reload the page.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms state and warns of the reload, matching watch_off's shape.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: Chưa bảo vệ trang này. Bật sẽ tải lại trang.
ext.popup.watch_off.back: Not guarding this site. Turning on will reload the page.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Heads the current-tab section, sits beside the trailing count.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Không theo dõi vì đang tắt bảo vệ.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Not tracked because guard is off.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22, no code reads it; written speculatively to match the voice of sibling states.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Trang này chưa cố mở đến nơi nào khác.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page hasn't tried to reach anywhere else yet.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly nothing has reached out from this page so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.s: Chưa có gì để hiển thị.
ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key, near-synonym of page_quiet; kept as a plain equivalent rather than inventing new phrasing.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Vietnamese has no plural form; identical text to stopped_other, which is the pair's 'other' case.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Same string as stopped_one; Vietnamese collapses the singular/plural pair.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Broader than 'stopped': every recorded attempt, blocked and allowed together.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Same string as seen_one; no plural inflection in Vietnamese.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse fragment meant to sit among other short tags in one detail line.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same string as tries_one; Vietnamese does not distinguish the count grammatically.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Short prefix that reads naturally before ': <recipe name>'.

ext.state.blocked.why: Most-reused status word; combines with a following scope fragment.

ext.state.allowed.why: Clear opposite of 'Đã chặn', same combination rule with scope words.

ext.state.removed.why: Names a trap taken off the page directly, no destination to rule on.

ext.scope.here.why: Composed as '${verdict} ${scope}', e.g. 'Đã chặn trên trang này'.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Đã chặn ở mọi nơi'.

ext.scope.default.why: Composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Đã chặn theo mặc định'.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Menu option scoped to the current site, distinct from the everywhere variant.

ext.action.allow_everywhere.why: Menu option scoped to every guarded site.

ext.action.block_here.why: Menu option scoped to the current site.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Menu option scoped to every guarded site.

ext.popup.policy_heading.s: Xử lý đích đến chưa có quy tắc
ext.popup.policy_heading.back: Handling for a destination with no rule
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same concept as the app's settings equivalent, separate translation unit.

ext.policy.block.why: Radio option, matches the container app's phrasing.

ext.policy.allow.why: Radio option, matches the container app's phrasing.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Cài đặt bảo mật của trang này chặn một phần tiện ích, nên bảo vệ chỉ hoạt động một phần.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's own security settings block part of the extension, so guard only works partially.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Frames it as a limitation of this one page, not a bug.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Names the invisible clickable-element trick as a terse noun phrase.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than the click trap: any see-through element over the page.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own script dispatched, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Standard Vietnamese term for a script-opened pop-up window.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Names the link-rewritten-mid-press trick, terse tag shape.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names a navigation fired right after the back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab redirect trick as a short tag.

ext.kind.pop_tab.s: Tab mới mở lén phía sau
ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names a tab-under style new tab opened behind the press.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, strongest kind of block, before the page ever saw it.

ext.reason.way_back.s: Địa chỉ có đường quay lại trang gốc.
ext.reason.way_back.back: The address has a path back to the origin site.
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains why a redirect with a round-trip path was allowed.

ext.reason.sized.s: Cửa sổ mở đúng kích thước riêng.
ext.reason.sized.back: The window opened at its own set size.
ext.reason.sized.why: Explains why a deliberately sized window was allowed.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short reason for a block: the destination rode a press aimed elsewhere.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Very short reason: nothing flagged it, so the default policy let it through.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains a window was allowed because the site's own code opened it.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Reused as the nav row, the Rules screen's header, and the back-button label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names the destination a chevron-only back button returns to, for screen readers.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Matches app.rules.grouping.everywhere so the two surfaces read the same.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Matches app.rules.grouping.by_site, clear counterpart to 'Mọi nơi'.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse single-row placeholder for an empty rules section.

ext.action.allow.why: Row menu option, scope already fixed by which section the row sits in.

ext.action.block.why: Row menu option, opposite of 'Cho phép'.

ext.action.clear.why: Same wording as app.rules.row.use_default, since it is the same action seen from two surfaces.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Reused as the nav row and that screen's own header title.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: State label for the master switch, matches the generic on-state word.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Tighter than the app-side label to fit the popup's smaller layout.

ext.action.report.why: Names opening a pre-filled report; nothing is sent until the person submits it.
